r1.name: Amina Hassan
r1.quote: Zanzibaba brought our resort to life in a way we didn't think was possible. The film performed on every channel we placed it on and our direct bookings went up 38% in the first quarter.
r1.photoAlt: Amina Hassan, Marketing Director at Zuri Resort

r2.name: Luca Romano
r2.quote: The drone work over Mnemba was some of the best aerial footage we've ever licensed. They understand tourism, the platforms, and what makes a viewer hit 'book'.
r2.photoAlt: Luca Romano, Head of Brand at AquaTour

r3.name: Sofia Müller
r3.quote: Fast, professional, and creatively brave. Our villa inquiries doubled in the month the new content went live. We renewed them for a second year before the first campaign ended.
r3.photoAlt: Sofia Müller, Owner of The Lighthouse Villa

r4.name: Daniel Mwangi
r4.quote: Working with Zanzibaba on our in-flight tourism channel has been transformative. Their footage of Zanzibar is now seen by 200,000+ passengers a year.

r5.name: Layla Khan
r5.quote: Premium quality, fast turnaround, and a real understanding of luxury hospitality. They are our go-to production partner for the entire East Africa region.
r5.photoAlt: Layla Khan, Head of Marketing at Serena Hotels

r6.name: Tom Becker
r6.quote: The team captured our spice tours, dolphin trips and Stone Town walks with the same cinematic care most agencies reserve for 5-star resorts. Genuinely impressive.
r6.photoAlt: Tom Becker, Founder of Zanzibar Adventures
